context: Tests the default-stream happy path: one detection call, one read, a report built from the file rather than re-synthesised.

checklist.name: Detection command issued
checklist.description: Runs `ls -t` over the session and done/ CONTEXT files, with or without an `rtk` prefix

checklist.name: Detection and read are parallel
checklist.description: The detection call and the read of CONTEXT-llm.md are issued in the same message

checklist.name: Default filename used
checklist.description: Reads `.context/session/CONTEXT-llm.md` with no stream segment in the name

checklist.name: No question asked
checklist.description: Does not ask the user which stream to load when only one file exists

checklist.name: Header fields shown
checklist.description: Report always shows Stream, Saved, Focus and Goal

checklist.name: NextTasks shown
checklist.description: Report lists the top 3 NextTasks in their saved order

checklist.name: Session context shown
checklist.description: Report includes a Session Context block taken from the file

checklist.name: Hot files shown
checklist.description: Report includes a Hot Files block

checklist.name: Single-sentence next step
checklist.description: Ends with one Next Step sentence derived from NextTasks[0] and the focus field

checklist.name: No re-synthesis
checklist.description: Presents parsed data directly instead of rewording or re-ordering the saved content
